ayahs.1: Yeh log aap se ghanimaton ka hukm daryaft karte hain, aap farma dijiye! Ke yeh ghanimatein Allah ki hain aur Rasool ki hain, so tum Allah se daro aur apne baahami taalluqaat ki islaah karo aur Allah Taala aur us ke Rasool ki itaat karo agar tum imaan wale ho.
ayahs.2: Bas imaan wale to aise hote hain ke jab Allah Taala ka zikr aata hai to un ke quloob dar jaate hain aur jab Allah ki aayatein un ko padh kar sunaayi jaati hain to woh aayatein un ke imaan ko aur ziyaada kar deti hain aur woh log apne Rabb par tawakkul karte hain.
ayahs.3: Jo ke namaaz ki paabandi karte hain aur hum ne un ko jo kuch diya hai woh us mein se kharch karte hain.
ayahs.4: Sachche imaan wale yeh log hain, un ke liye bade darje hain un ke Rabb ke paas aur maghfirat aur izzat ki rozi hai.
ayahs.5: Jaisa ke aap ke Rabb ne aap ke ghar se haq ke saath aap ko rawana kiya aur musalmaanon ki ek jamaat is ko giraan samajhti thi.
ayahs.6: Woh is haq ke baare mein, is ke baad ke is ka zuhoor ho gaya tha, aap se is tarah jhagad rahe the ke goya koi un ko maut ki taraf haanke liye jaata hai aur woh dekh rahe hain.
ayahs.7: Aur tum log us waqt ko yaad karo! Jab ke Allah tum se un do jamaaton mein se ek ka waada karta tha ke woh tumhare haath aa jaayegi aur tum is tamanna mein the ke ghair musallah jamaat tumhare haath aa jaaye aur Allah Taala ko yeh manzoor tha ke apne ahkaam se haq ka haq hona sabit kar de aur un kaafiron ki jad kaat de.
ayahs.8: Taake haq ka haq hona aur baatil ka baatil hona sabit kar de go yeh mujrim log na-pasand hi karen.
ayahs.9: Us waqt ko yaad karo jab ke tum apne Rabb se faryaad kar rahe the, phir Allah Taala ne tumhari sun li ke main tum ko ek hazaar farishton se madad doonga jo lagataar chale aayenge.
ayahs.10: Aur Allah Taala ne yeh imdad mehaz is liye ki ke bashaarat ho aur taake tumhare dilon ko qaraar ho jaaye aur madad sirf Allah hi ki taraf se hai jo ke zabardast hikmat wala hai.
ayahs.11: Us waqt ko yaad karo jab ke Allah tum par ongh taari kar raha tha apni taraf se chain dene ke liye aur tum par aasmaan se paani barsa raha tha ke is paani ke zariye se tum ko paak kar de aur tum se shaitaani waswasa ko dafa kar de aur tumhare dilon ko mazboot kar de aur tumhare paaon jama de.
ayahs.12: Us waqt ko yaad karo jab ke aap ka Rabb farishton ko hukm deta tha ke main tumhara saathi hoon so tum imaan walon ki himmat badhaao, main abhi kuffaar ke quloob mein roab daale deta hoon, so tum gardanon par maaro aur un ke por por ko maaro.
ayahs.13: Yeh is baat ki saza hai ke unhon ne Allah ki aur us ke Rasool ki mukhaalifat ki. Aur jo Allah ki aur us ke Rasool ki mukhaalifat karta hai so be-shak Allah Taala sakht saza dene wala hai.
ayahs.14: So yeh saza chakkho aur jaan rakho ke kaafiron ke liye jahannam ka azaab muqarrar hi hai.
ayahs.15: Aye imaan walo! Jab tum kaafiron se do-ba-do muqabil ho jaao to un se pusht mat pherna.
ayahs.16: Aur jo shakhs un se is mauqa par pusht pherega, magar haan jo ladaai ke liye paintra badalta ho ya jo (apni) jamaat ki taraf panaah lene aata ho woh mustasna hai. Baqi aur jo aisa karega woh Allah ke ghazab mein aa jaayega aur us ka thikana dozakh hoga, woh bahut hi buri jagah hai.
ayahs.17: So tum ne unhein qatl nahi kiya lekin Allah Taala ne un ko qatl kiya. Aur aap ne khaak ki mutthi nahi phenki balke Allah Taala ne woh phenki aur taake musalmaanon ko apni taraf se un ki mehnat ka khoob iwaz de, bila-shubha Allah Taala khoob sunne wala khoob jaanne wala hai.
ayahs.18: (Ek baat to) yeh hui aur (doosri baat yeh hai) Allah Taala ko kaafiron ki tadbeer ko kamzor karna tha.
ayahs.19: Agar tum log faisla chaahte ho to woh faisla tumhare saamne aa maujood hua aur agar baaz aa jaao to yeh tumhare liye nihaayat khoob hai aur agar tum phir wohi kaam karoge to hum bhi phir wohi kaam karenge aur tumhari jamiyat tumhare zara bhi kaam na aayegi go kitni ziyaada ho aur waaqai baat yeh hai ke Allah Taala imaan walon ke saath hai.
ayahs.20: Aye imaan walo! Allah ka aur us ke Rasool ka kehna maano aur is (ka kehna maanne) se rugardaani mat karo sunte jaante hue.
ayahs.21: Aur tum un logon ki tarah mat hona jo dawa to karte hain ke hum ne sun liya haalaanke woh sunte (sunaate kuch) nahi.
ayahs.22: Be-shak badtareen khalaiq Allah Taala ke nazdeek woh log hain jo behre hain goonge hain jo ke (zara) nahi samajhte.
ayahs.23: Aur agar Allah Taala un mein koi khoobi dekhta to un ko sunne ki taufeeq de deta aur agar un ko ab suna de to zaroor rugardaani karenge be-rukhi karte hue.
ayahs.24: Aye imaan walo! Tum Allah aur Rasool ke kehne ko baja laao, jab ke Rasool tum ko tumhari zindagi bakhsh cheez ki taraf bulaate hon aur jaan rakho ke Allah Taala aadmi ke aur us ke qalb ke darmiyaan aar ban jaaya karta hai aur bila-shubha tum sab ko Allah hi ke paas jama hona hai.
ayahs.25: Aur tum aise wabaal se bacho! Ke jo khaas kar sirf un hi logon par waaqe na hoga jo tum mein se un gunaahon ke murtakib hue hain aur yeh jaan rakho ke Allah sakht saza dene wala hai.
ayahs.26: Aur us halat ko yaad karo! Jab ke tum zameen mein qaleel the, kamzor shumar kiye jate the. Is andeshe mein rehte the ke tum ko log noch-khasot na len, so Allah ne tum ko rehne ki jagah di aur tum ko apni nusrat se quwwat di aur tum ko nafees nafees cheezein ata farmain taake tum shukar karo.
ayahs.27: Aye imaan walo! Tum Allah aur Rasool (ke huqooq) mein jante hue khayanat mat karo aur apni qabil-e-hifazat cheezon mein khayanat mat karo.
ayahs.28: Aur tum is baat ko jaan rakho ke tumhare amwaal aur tumhari aulaad ek imtihaan ki cheez hai. Aur is baat ko bhi jaan rakho ke Allah Taala ke paas bada bhari ajr hai.
ayahs.29: Aye imaan walo! Agar tum Allah se darte rahoge to Allah Taala tum ko ek faisla ki cheez dega aur tum se tumhare gunaah door kar dega aur tum ko bakhsh dega aur Allah Taala bade fazl wala hai.
ayahs.30: Aur is waaqia ka bhi zikr kijiye! Jab ke kaafir log aap ki nisbat tadbeer soch rahe the ke aap ko qaid kar len, ya aap ko qatl kar dalen ya aap ko kharij-e-watan kar den aur woh to apni tadbeerein kar rahe the aur Allah apni tadbeer kar raha tha aur sab se ziyaada mustahkam tadbeer wala Allah hai.
ayahs.31: Aur jab un ke samne hamari aayatein padhi jati hain to kehte hain ke hum ne sun liya, agar hum chahen to is ke baraabar hum bhi keh den, yeh to kuch bhi nahi sirf be-sanad batein hain jo pehlon se manqool chali aa rahi hain.
ayahs.32: Aur jab ke un logon ne kaha ke Aye Allah! Agar yeh Quran aap ki taraf se waaqai hai to hum par aasmaan se patthar barsa ya hum par koi dardnaak azaab waqe kar de.
ayahs.33: Aur Allah Taala aisa na karega ke un mein aap ke hote hue un ko azaab de aur Allah un ko azaab na dega is haalat mein ke woh istighfar bhi karte hon.
ayahs.34: Aur un mein kya baat hai ke un ko Allah Taala saza na de haalaanke woh log Masjid-e-Haram se rokte hain, jab ke woh log is masjid ke mutawalli nahi. Is ke mutawalli to siwa muttaqiyon ke aur ashkhas nahi, lekin un mein aksar log ilm nahi rakhte.
ayahs.35: Aur un ki namaaz Kaaba ke paas sirf yeh thi seetiyan bajana aur taaliyan bajana. So apne kufr ke sabab is azaab ka maza chakkho.
ayahs.36: Bila-shak yeh kaafir log apne maalon ko is liye kharch kar rahe hain ke Allah ki raah se roken so yeh log to apne maalon ko kharch karte hi rahenge, phir woh maal un ke haq mein baais-e-hasrat ho jaayenge. Phir maghloob ho jaayenge aur kaafir logon ko dozakh ki taraf jama kiya jaayega.
ayahs.37: Taake Allah Taala napaak ko paak se alag kar de aur napaakon ko ek doosre se mila de, pas un sab ko ikattha dher kar de phir un sab ko jahannam mein daal de. Aise log poore khasaare mein hain.
ayahs.38: Aap un kaafiron se keh dijiye! Ke agar yeh log baaz aa jaayen to un ke saare gunaah jo pehle ho chuke hain sab maaf kar diye jaayenge aur agar apni wohi aadat rakhenge to (kuffaar) saabiqeen ke haq mein qanoon nafiz ho chuka hai.
ayahs.39: Aur tum un se is had tak lado ke un mein fasaad-e-aqeeda na rahe. Aur deen Allah hi ka ho jaaye phir agar yeh baaz aa jaayen to Allah Taala un aamaal ko khoob dekhta hai.
ayahs.40: Aur agar rugardaani karen to yaqeen rakhen ke Allah Taala tumhara kaarsaaz hai woh bahut achchha kaarsaaz hai aur bahut achchha madadgaar hai.
ayahs.41: Jaan lo ke tum jis qism ki jo kuch ghaneemat haasil karo is mein se panchwan hissa to Allah ka hai aur Rasool ka aur qarabat-daron ka aur yateemon aur miskeenon ka aur musafiron ka, agar tum Allah par imaan laaye ho aur is cheez par jo hum ne apne bande par is din utara hai, jo din haq-o-batil ki judai ka tha jis din do faujein bhid gayi thin. Allah har cheez par qadir hai.
ayahs.42: Jab ke tum paas wale kinaare par the aur woh door wale kinaare par the aur qaafila tum se neeche tha. Agar tum aapas mein waade karte to yaqeenan tum waqt-e-muayyan par pahunchne mein mukhtalif ho jaate. Lekin Allah ko to ek kaam kar hi daalna tha jo muqarrar ho chuka tha taake jo halaak ho, daleel par (yaani yaqeen jaan kar) halaak ho aur jo zinda rahe, woh bhi daleel par (haq pehchaan kar) zinda rahe. Be-shak Allah bahut sunne wala khoob jaanne wala hai.
ayahs.43: Jab ke Allah Taala ne tujhe tere khwaab mein un ki tadaad kam dikhai, agar un ki ziyaadati dikhata to tum buzdil ho jate aur is kaam ke baare mein aapas mein ikhtilaf karte lekin Allah Taala ne bacha liya, woh dilon ke bhedon se khoob aagaah hai.
ayahs.44: Jabke us ne ba-waqt-e-mulaqaat unhein tumhari nigahon mein bahut kam dikhaye aur tumhein un ki nigahon mein kam dikhaye taake Allah Taala is kaam ko anjaam tak pahuncha de jo karna hi tha aur sab kaam Allah hi ki taraf phere jaate hain.
ayahs.45: Aye imaan walo! Jab tum kisi mukhalif fauj se bhid jaao to saabit-qadam raho aur bakasrat Allah ko yaad karo taake tumhein kaamyaabi haasil ho.
ayahs.46: Aur Allah ki aur us ke Rasool ki farmaan-bardaari karte raho, aapas mein ikhtilaf na karo warna buzdil ho jaaoge aur tumhari hawa ukhad jaayegi aur sabr-o-sahaara rakho, yaqeenan Allah Taala sabr karne walon ke saath hai.
ayahs.47: Un logon jaise na bano jo itrate hue aur logon mein khud-numaai karte hue apne gharon se chale aur Allah ki raah se rokte the, jo kuch woh kar rahe hain Allah ise gher lene wala hai.
ayahs.48: Jabke un ke aamaal ko shaitaan unhein zeenat-dar dikha raha tha aur keh raha tha ke logon mein se koi bhi aaj tum par ghalib nahi aa sakta, main khud bhi tumhara himayati hoon lekin jab donon jamaatein namoodar huin to apni ediyon ke bal peechhe hat gaya aur kehne laga main tum se bari hoon. Main woh dekh raha hoon jo tum nahi dekh rahe. Main Allah se darta hoon, aur Allah Taala sakht azaab wala hai.
ayahs.49: Jabke munaafiq keh rahe the aur woh bhi jin ke dilon mein rog tha ke unhein to un ke deen ne dhoke mein daal diya hai jo bhi Allah par bharosa kare Allah Taala bila-shak-o-shubha ghalbe wala aur hikmat wala hai.
ayahs.50: Kash ke tu dekhta jab ke farishte kaafiron ki rooh qabz karte hain un ke munh par aur sareenon par maar marte hain (aur kehte hain) tum jalne ka azaab chakho.
ayahs.51: Yeh ba-sabab un kaamon ke jo tumhare haathon ne pehle hi bhej rakha hai be-shak Allah apne bandon par zulm karne wala nahi.
ayahs.52: Misl Firauniyon ke haal ke aur un se aglon ke, ke unhon ne Allah ki aayaton se kufr kiya pas Allah ne un ke gunaahon ke baais inhein pakad liya. Allah Taala yaqeenan quwwat wala aur sakht azaab wala hai.
ayahs.53: Yeh is liye ke Allah Taala aisa nahi ke kisi qaum par koi nemat inaam farma kar phir badal de jab tak ke woh khud apni is haalat ko na badal den jo ke un ki apni thi aur yeh ke Allah sunne wala jaanne wala hai.
ayahs.54: Misl haalat Firauniyon ke aur un se pehle ke logon ke ke unhon ne apne Rabb ki batein jhutlayin. Pas un ke gunaahon ke baais hum ne inhein barbaad kiya aur Firauniyon ko dubo diya. Yeh sare zaalim the.
ayahs.55: Tamaam jaandaaron se badtar, Allah ke nazdeek woh hain jo kufr karen, phir woh imaan na laayen.
ayahs.56: Jin se aap ne ahd-o-paiman kar liya phir bhi woh apne ahd-o-paiman ko har martaba tod dete hain aur bilkul parhez nahi karte.
ayahs.57: Pas jab kabhi to ladai mein un par ghalib aa jaaye inhein aisi maar maar ke un ke pichhle bhi bhaag khade hon, ho sakta hai ke woh ibrat haasil karen.
ayahs.58: Aur agar tujhe kisi qaum ki khayaanat ka dar ho to barabari ki haalat mein un ka ahd-nama tod de, Allah Taala khayaanat karne walon ko pasand nahi farmaata.
ayahs.59: Kafir yeh khayaal na karen ke woh bhaag nikle. Yaqeenan woh aajiz nahi kar sakte.
ayahs.60: Tum un ke muqaable ke liye apni taaqat bhar quwwat ki tayyaari karo aur ghodon ke tayyaar rakhne ki ke is se tum Allah ke dushmanon ko khauf-zada rakh sako aur un ke siwa auron ko bhi, jinhein tum nahi jante, Allah inhein khoob jaan raha hai jo kuch bhi Allah ki raah mein sarf karoge woh tumhein poora poora diya jaayega aur tumhara haq na mara jaayega.
ayahs.61: Agar woh sulah ki taraf jhuken to tu bhi sulah ki taraf jhuk ja aur Allah par bharosa rakh, yaqeenan woh bahut sunne jaanne wala hai.
ayahs.62: Agar woh tujh se dagha-baazi karna chaahenge to Allah tujhe kaafi hai, isi ne apni madad se aur mominon se teri taa'eed ki hai.
ayahs.63: Un ke dilon mein baahami ulfat bhi isi ne daali hai. Zameen mein jo kuch hai to agar saara ka saara bhi kharch kar dalta hai to bhi un ke dil aapas mein na mila sakta. Yeh to Allah hi ne un mein ulfat daal di hai woh ghalib hikmaton wala hai.
ayahs.64: Aye Nabi! Tujhe Allah kaafi hai aur un mominon ko jo teri pairawi kar rahe hain.
ayahs.65: Aye Nabi! Imaan walon ko jihaad ka shauq dilaao agar tum mein bees bhi sabr karne wale honge, to do sau par ghalib rahenge. Aur agar tum mein ek sau honge to ek hazaar kafiron par ghalib rahenge is waaste ke woh be-samajh log hain.
ayahs.66: Achchha ab Allah tumhara bojh halka karta hai, woh khoob jaanta hai ke tum mein naatawani hai, pas agar tum mein se ek sau sabr karne wale honge to woh do sau par ghalib rahenge aur agar tum mein se ek hazaar honge to woh Allah ke hukm se do hazaar par ghalib rahenge, Allah sabr karne walon ke saath hai.
ayahs.67: Nabi ke haath mein qaidi nahi chaahiye jab tak ke mulk mein achchhi khoonrezi ki jang na ho jaaye. Tum to dunya ke maal chaahte ho aur Allah ka iraada aakhirat ka hai aur Allah zor-awar ba-hikmat hai.
ayahs.68: Agar pehle hi se Allah ki taraf se baat likhi hui na hoti to jo kuch tum ne liya hai is ke baare mein tumhein koi badi saza hoti.
ayahs.69: Pas jo kuch halaal aur pakeeza ghaneemat tum ne haasil ki hai, khoob khaao piyo aur Allah se darte raho, yaqeenan Allah Ghafoor wa Raheem hai.
ayahs.70: Aye Nabi! Apne haath tale ke qaidiyon se keh do ke agar Allah Taala tumhare dilon mein nek niyati dekhega to jo kuch tum se liya gaya hai is se behtar tumhein dega aur phir gunaah bhi maaf farmaayega aur Allah bakhshne wala meharbaan hai hi.
ayahs.71: Aur agar woh tujh se khayaanat ka khayaal karenge to yeh to is se pehle khud Allah ki khayaanat kar chuke hain aakhir is ne inhein giraftaar kara diya, aur Allah ilm-o-hikmat wala hai.
ayahs.72: Jo log imaan laaye aur hijrat ki aur apne maalon aur jaanon se Allah ki raah mein jihaad kiya aur jin logon ne un ko panaah di aur madad ki, yeh sab aapas mein ek doosre ke rafeeq hain, aur jo imaan to laaye hain lekin hijrat nahi ki tumhare liye un ki kuch bhi rafaqat nahi jab tak ke woh hijrat na karen. Haan agar woh tum se deen ke baare mein madad talab karen to tum par madad karna zaroori hai, siwaaye un logon ke ke tum mein aur un mein ahd-o-paiman hai, tum jo kuch kar rahe ho Allah khoob dekhta hai.
ayahs.73: Kaafir aapas mein ek doosre ke rafeeq hain, agar tum ne aisa na kiya to mulk mein fitna hoga aur zabardast fasaad ho jaayega.
ayahs.74: Jo log imaan laaye aur hijrat ki aur Allah ki raah mein jihaad kiya aur jinhon ne panaah di aur madad pahunchai, yahi log sachche momin hain, un ke liye bakhshish hai aur izzat ki rozi.
ayahs.75: Aur jo log is ke baad imaan laaye aur hijrat ki aur tumhare saath ho kar jihaad kiya. Pas yeh log bhi tum mein se hi hain aur rishte naate wale un mein se baaz baaz se ziyaada nazdeek hain Allah ke hukm mein, be-shak Allah Taala har cheez ka jaanne wala hai.
